title: Looks nice, suction cups don't work.
text: Looks nice, suction cups don't work.. This would get 5 stars, but the suction cups don't work at all.  It's attractive and well made, but the suction cups are useless.  They do not suction at all.  I purchased 2 of these and they both have the same problem.  The surface is smooth and clean, but the cups don't stick.

product_metadata.title: iDesign 61971 York Lyra Hanging Shower Organizer - 10" x 4" x 22", Bronze
features: ALL-IN-ONE HANGING SHOWER ORGANIZER: Features two wide storage shelves and six hanging hooks to keep bathroom necessities within reach
MULTI-PURPOSE STORAGE HOOKS: Innovative storage hook design accommodates standard-sized razors in addition to washcloths, loofahs, sponges, and brushes
EASY INSTALLATION: Simply place the organizer over the top of the shower head and push the suction cups into place on the wall to set up - no mounting or hardware required!
MADE WITH RUST-RESISTANT STEEL: Durable steel construction with rust-resistant bronze finish stands up to every day use and is easy to clean with mild soap and water
EFFICIENT SIZE: Measures 10" x 4" x 22" to add instant organization in unused space in the shower
description: Upgrade your bathroom storage with the iDesign York Lyra Hanging Shower Caddy. This all-in-one organizer features two wide storage shelves and six hanging hooks to keep bathroom necessities such as shampoo and conditioner bottles, shower gel, bar soap, toothbrushes, toothpaste, and more within reach in the shower or bathtub. The multi-purpose storage hooks are designed to fit standard-sized razors in addition to washcloths, loofahs, sponges, and brushes. The open wire design provides proper airflow and allows items to dry more efficiently after use, while the two integrated suction cups and non-slip grip ensure a secure hold in wet or dry conditions. Simply place the organizer over the top of the shower head and push the suction cups into place on the wall to set up - no mounting or hardware required! The durable steel construction with rust-resistant bronze finish stands up to every day use and is easy to clean with mild soap and water. Measuring 10" x 4" x 22", this storage caddy adds instant organization in unused space in the shower. With iDesign by InterDesign, you can #LiveSimply every day.
This York Lyra Shower Caddy bring classic American style to your shower space. Its 2 shelves can accommodate larger bottles and have hooks for towels, loofahs and brushes.
